live_checks.requirement: Observed chain ID, genesis hash, evidence block number/hash and public endpoint identity match the official production-equivalent testnet manifest.
ProviderRegistry, FeedRegistry, RiskPolicy and OracleRouter deployed addresses/code hashes and immutable constructor bindings are verified on the same exact release lineage.
ProtocolRegistry actively resolves 420/service/oracle/v1 to the exact deployed OracleRouter runtime/version.
Provider/feed/source/risk configuration succeeds only through the deployed governance authority and unauthorized configuration is rejected.
At least two independent active provider identities/operators are provisioned for representative quorum feeds with non-secret metadata and reviewed operator key custody.
Independent live provider submissions produce a canonical MEDIAN_NUMERIC read with correct decimals, conservative confidence, spread metadata and configured quorum.
Independent live provider submissions produce a canonical QUORUM_EQUAL result read and conflicting qualifying quorums fail closed.
Stale, future-dated, inactive-feed and insufficient-source states fail closed on the deployed router.
Observation-ID replay and equal/older provider timestamps are rejected in deployed state.
Feed revision, provider reactivation and source reactivation invalidate observations from prior authority/configuration epochs.
Minimum confidence, maximum deviation and circuit-breaker policy fail closed on representative deployed feeds.
A deployed/read-only Swap TWAP adapter path reports canonical source provenance and stale/unhealthy source state fails closed without gaining provider authority merely by deployment.
420Automation consumes canonical Oracle facts from the verified router while preserving chain/router/feed identity, freshness/confidence/quorum policy and eligibility-only authority.
Provider/operator restart and chain/indexer reorg/reconciliation drills do not manufacture canonical observations, resurrect invalidated data or misreport stale/reorged evidence as current.

evidence_policy: Repository tests, local EVM deployments and synthetic fixtures validate the harness only and never satisfy ORACLE-AUDIT-7 live checks.
Every retained live check must bind to one exact implementation SHA, official chain ID/genesis identity, evidence block/hash and exact deployed runtime/code hashes.

Provider/operator evidence must identify independent provider IDs/operators and configuration transactions without committing private keys, seed phrases, authenticated RPC URLs, bearer tokens or other secrets.

Missing official manifest, placeholder endpoints, unresolved ProtocolRegistry service, missing deployed code, insufficient provider diversity, stale/conflicting evidence or missing live receipts must fail closed.
blocker: The repository launch authority states that the production-equivalent public testnet is not yet authorized/live; the official testnet manifest is absent, chain ID is not frozen, and public endpoints remain placeholders.
